_about: laneFOGSSGI v1. OFF by default: 'enabled' false and no -fogtune: argument = FogSsgiTuning does nothing. A profile edits scene objects BY NAME at start-up: local fog volumes (enable 0 = component off, fadeStart/fadeEnd = distance fade in m from the camera, -1 = leave, densityMul > 1 = denser: meanFreePath / densityMul) and light volumetricDimmer / volumetricFadeDistance (-1 = leave). Select with 'active' (and enabled true) or with -fogtune:<id> on the command line (the argument wins, enabled is ignored then). Every profile except the *_MEAS one CHANGES THE LOOK and needs Dom's LOOK OK before it is turned on for real. DoorHaze is left out of every cut on purpose: GatewayRift scales its density at runtime. Volume and light names come from hdrp_lighting_ultra.json (fogVolumes / lights / extra). The volume-level knobs (fog depth extent, slices, denoise mode, cutoff, SSGI steps, denoiser switches) are NOT here: they are RuntimeQuality.Flags keys (fogManual fogScreenPct fogSlices fogDepthExtent fogDepthRatio fogDenoise fogAniso fogUniformity fogCutoff fogDirOnly ssgiSteps ssgiDenoise ssgiHalfDenoise ssgiSecondDenoise ssgiRadius ssgiThickness ssgiRayMiss), -1 = leave as authored, set through runtime_flags.json, a quality tier or -qset:.

profiles.what: BankHazeL + BankHazeR off (they overlap the bridge and moat strips; additive blend)
profiles.look: LOOK: the fog strips beside the bridge thin out; overlap seams lose their double density

profiles.what: MoatHazeL, MoatHazeR, MoatHazeFront off (36x2.5x60, 36x2.5x60, 60x2.5x20 m, the largest footprints)
profiles.look: LOOK: ground mist over the moat disappears at the frame edges

profiles.what: BridgeHazeL + BridgeHazeR off (6x2.5x28 m each, directly in view)
profiles.look: LOOK: the mist lying on the bridge sides disappears

profiles.what: MEASUREMENT ONLY: all 7 non-door lighting volumes off, to see what the local volumes cost together
MoonFill, FillCool, MoonRim stop lighting the fog (volumetricDimmer 0); only Key_ColdSun lights it. Cuts 3 of 4 directional-light evaluations per lit voxel
profiles.look: LOOK: fog loses its cool fill tint and some back light on the haze

profiles.what: DoorShadowWarm (point light with a cube shadow) stops lighting the fog
profiles.look: LOOK: the door glow shafts lose their shadowed part

profiles.what: key light (Key_ColdSun) volumetricDimmer up so the sun shafts through gaps/trunks/arches read; start value
profiles.look: LOOK: sun-facing views gain visible beams where the 2 sun cascades (shadowDistance 40 m) are blocked; off-axis views change little (HG g 0.6)
LOOK: stronger beams, brighter global haze toward the sun; check Joan/boss readability
